subject: fix/free some parameters for some groups -multigroup

messages.author: d031878e1659da84
messages.subject: fix/free some parameters for some groups -multigroup
parts:
Hello everybody,

I have what it seems a super simple question, but I am just switching from Lisrel to Lavaan, and I haven't found anything useful to solve these very basic problem (maybe it would be good to add it in the just released lavaan tutorial).

I need to be able to free some loadings/Intercepts for some groups only.

I found that group.partial makes a group of parameters equal across ALL groups, but what I want is to free the loading from variable " impcntr" in groups 13, 25 for instance.

I also wanted to indicate using lavaan and not cfa that the  latent meaning in the first group should be 0 and freely estimated for all groups. My solution so far is to introduce a vector with the values of what I want to set free or fixed

#for loadings:
reject =~ imsmetn + 1*imdfetn + c(NA, NA, 0.....NA, 0, NA....etc) * impcntr
#for latent variable mean:
reject ~ c(0, rep(NA,50)*1'

Is this the way to do it or is there a more straightforward solution???


My code:
invariance <- # one-factor model/ 3 Observed indicators
  ' reject =~ imsmetn + 1*imdfetn + impcntr


  # intercepts
  imsmetn ~ 1
  imdfetn ~ 1
  impcntr ~ 1'
reject ~ c(0, rep(NA,50)*1'

fit <- lavaan(invariance,
           data=ess,
           auto.fix.first=F,
           auto.var=T,
           auto.cov.y=F,
           group=c("cntryround"), #Multigroup variable
           group.equal=c("loadings", # Making loadings equal (metric invariance)
                        "intercepts")) #,# Making intercepts equal (scalar invariance)

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: fix/free some parameters for some groups -multigroup
parts: This was not answered before, so better late than never:

On 03/26/2014 04:19 PM, Diana Zavala Rojas wrote:
> I need to be able to free some loadings/Intercepts for some groups only.

In this case, it is better NOT to use the group.equal= argument
altogether, but use labels.

> I found that group.partial makes a group of parameters equal across ALL
> groups, but what I want is to free the loading from variable " impcntr"
> in groups 13, 25 for instance.

You would need something like:

reject =~ c(a,a,a,a,a,a,...,b,a,a,a,a,....,c,....)*impcntr

where all labels are 'a' (and hence all the same), except for the 13th
and 25th, which have a different label, and hence a different value.

> I also wanted to indicate using lavaan and not cfa that the latent
> meaning in the first group should be 0 and freely estimated for all
> groups. My solution so far is to introduce a vector with the values of
> what I want to set free or fixed

This is ok:

> reject ~ c(0, rep(NA,50)*1'

Yves.
